description: This file defines the class du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng, which manages aperiodic SRS resources in a DU (Distributed Unit) for a wireless communication system. It includes methods for resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration specific to cell and UE configurations, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng
classes.description: Manages aperiodic SRS resources for a DU, including resource allocation and configuration.

classes.name: cell_context
classes.description: Holds per-cell configuration and resource management data for SRS resources.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates SRS resources to UEs based on policy.

methods.name: get_nof_srs_free_res_offsets
methods.description: Returns the number of free resource offsets, always max in this implementation.

methods.name: cell_context::get_du_srs_res_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SRS resource configuration by cell resource ID.

methods.name: cell_context::fill_srs_res_parameters
methods.description: Fills SRS resource parameters for a UE.

methods.name: cell_context::fill_srs_res_set
methods.description: Fills SRS resource set list for a UE.
